Title: Butter Toffee Peanuts (Secret Peanuts)
Body (HTML): This tasty combination of rich butter toffee and fresh peanuts is our signature mix and best seller. Great on ice cream!

Title: Honey Cinnamon Almonds
Body (HTML): A delicious combination of not-too-sweet, aromatic cinnamon and freshly roasted almonds. Very popular and perfect for the holidays!

Title: Honey Roasted Cashews
Body (HTML): The perfect combination of buttery Brazilian cashews slow roasted in a sweet honey glaze. You will go simply nuts for this unique taste.

Title: Imperial Mix
Body (HTML): Colossal cashews, roasted and salted natural almonds, blanched almonds, Brazil nuts, and roasted filberts accented with jumbo pecans. (No peanuts)

Title: Jumbo Cashews
Body (HTML): We sell only whole cashews, not pieces. Hand-selected from Brazil to ensure quality, and slow roasted for sweet flavor and crisp texture. The best cashews you can buy.

Title: Louisiana Hot Nuts
Body (HTML): A scrumptious blend of chili pepper, garlic, and onion powder. You may want to have a cold beverage handy when indulging.

Title: Natural Pistachios
Body (HTML): These natural pistachios are the very best for the pistachio purist. Crack open a handful and taste their unique, one-of-a-kind goodness for yourself.

Title: Pecan Pralines
Body (HTML): The rich aroma of irresistible goodness comes packaged especially for you in our pecan pralines. Superb on salads and ice cream.

Title: Roasted Almonds
Body (HTML): Packed with only the finest plump California almonds, these west coast nuts are a true treat. A great source of vitamin E and folic acid.

Title: Cranberry Trail Mix
Body (HTML): Dried Wisconsin cranberries, golden raisins, roasted and salted almonds, Virginia red-skinned peanuts, sunflower and pumpkin seeds. Fruit and fiber all in one!

Title: Hot & Sassy Mix
Body (HTML): A hot, zesty blend of roasted and salted blanched and red-skinned peanuts, hot sesame sticks, chili crackers, sunflower and pumpkin seeds, and corn nuts.

Title: Sesame Mix
Body (HTML): Great as a snack or on salads! A mix of sesame sticks, cheddar sesame sticks, and roasted and salted peanuts, cashews, almonds, pumpkin seeds and sunflower seeds.

Title: Ultra Berry
Body (HTML): Northern Wisconsin cranberries, Michigan blueberries, and Washington sour cherries make up this one-of-a-kind treat. Buy extra for baking!

Title: Chocolate Covered Almonds
Body (HTML): We take plump California almonds and cover them in a thick blanket of the finest milk chocolate. Hard to resist!

Title: Chocolate Covered Cashews
Body (HTML): Fresh cashews covered in delicious chocolate — a mouthwatering treat!

Title: Chocolate Double Dipped Peanuts
Body (HTML): Fresh jumbo Virginia peanuts are drowned in a thick creamy milk chocolate and then repeated, for a chocolate lover's dream.

Title: Malted Milk Balls
Body (HTML): Crisp & crunchy malted milk balls enrobed in our creamy milk chocolate. Always the first to go at any gathering.

Title: Secret Peanuts Surprise
Body (HTML): The ultimate blend of indulgence: Secret Toffee Peanuts paired perfectly with Double Dipped Chocolate Peanuts. A harmonious dance of rich buttery toffee and luscious chocolate — perfect for snacking or sharing.
